checkpoint_ranking.interpretation: AUC is the probability that a random official waterlogging point ranks wetter than a random point in the same study area. 0.5 = no signal; |z| >= 1.96 is the usual bar for calling it distinguishable from chance.
checkpoint_ranking.tolerance_note: reported as evidence, not as a pass/fail threshold

checkpoint_mechanism.interpretation: no_terrain_storage means topography cannot explain the reported flooding at this location; the drainage system is the likely cause. This is a mechanism diagnosis, not a prediction of flooding.
